title: Patricias Geheimnis
overview: Patricia (Petra Kleinert) and Ellen finance their studies with jobs at an escort service. When Ellen falls in love with a client, she quits. Shortly afterward, she is found dead in the Wadden Sea. Patricia doesn't believe it was an accident. She travels to the North Sea with her favorite client, Henning (Herbert Knaup), and gets a rude awakening…
